About Me

Who I Am

I am Md. Jubayer Al Mahmud Shishir, a B.Sc. graduate in Electrical and Electronic Engineering from Varendra University and currently pursuing an M.Sc. Eng. at the Institute of Information and Communication Technology (IICT), RUET.

My goal is to apply theoretical knowledge and practical skills to real-world engineering projects, collaborate with dynamic teams, and contribute to smarter and more sustainable solutions.
